headline: DataGrid selection and filtering, new page templates, and 19 more documented components
title: Aura & Community Updates
intro: DataGrid gained selection, resizing and filtering, community teams got new page templates, and 19 more components now have portable docs.

evals.name: Adoption
evals.subtitle: Aura coverage · higher is better
evals.description: How much of an AI-generated app is built from Aura components instead of custom or third-party code.

evals.name: Missed opportunities
evals.subtitle: Rebuilt instead of reused · lower is better
evals.description: Custom components the agent built even though Aura already has a documented equivalent.

evals.name: Quality
evals.subtitle: Usage-quality findings · lower is better
evals.description: Aura components that were restyled or used in ways the docs specifically say not to.

highlights.summary: DataGrid gained selection, resizing and filtering, community teams got ready-made page templates, and documentation grew to 20 components.

items.title: DataGrid keeps growing
items.text: Row selection with an action toolbar, column resizing and a flexible filter panel make DataGrid more useful for data-heavy apps.
items.label: View in Storybook

items.title: Page templates for community apps
items.text: A Record list, dashboard layouts and map layouts give teams ready-made starting points that install with one command.
items.label: See the templates

image.alt: Record list template with filters and a grid

items.title: 19 more components documented
items.text: Nineteen more components now have portable docs, bringing the total to 20.
items.label: Browse components

image.alt: Graphic: 19 more components with portable docs

thanks.summary: Fourteen people committed, reviewed or tested the work in this update.

components.summary: Seven updates landed: DataGrid selection, resizing, filtering and fixes, plus new community templates and a user avatar.

cards.title: DataGrid: resizing and selection
cards.subtitle: Aura
cards.text: Columns can be resized by dragging, and selecting rows reveals an action toolbar with the selected count and actions.
cards.label: View in Storybook

image.alt: Action toolbar with 8 selected, Clear, icon actions and a primary button

cards.title: DataGrid: filtering and result count
cards.subtitle: Aura
cards.text: The filter panel supports per-column operators, and the result count text is configurable with header and footer slots apps can place themselves.
cards.label: View in Storybook

image.alt: DataGrid with a filter trigger in its toolbar

cards.title: DataGrid: fixes
cards.subtitle: Aura
cards.text: Paginated grids return to the first page when data, sorting or search changes, and date cells show readable values instead of raw ISO strings.
cards.label: View in Storybook

cards.title: Mermaid and code blocks
cards.subtitle: Aura
cards.text: Mermaid diagrams can go fullscreen again, and code block buttons are no longer clipped.
cards.label: View in Storybook

cards.title: Record list
cards.subtitle: Community template
cards.text: Six list layouts pair a header or tabs with a full-width grid, side panel or preview.
cards.label: See the template

image.alt: Record list template with filters and a grid

cards.title: Dashboard and map layouts
cards.subtitle: Community templates
cards.text: Ready-made page layouts for dashboard and map screens.
cards.label: See the template

image.alt: Dashboard page layout with header, tiles and charts

cards.title: User avatar
cards.subtitle: Community
cards.text: Turn a user identifier into an avatar and display name with one component.
cards.label: View Avatar in Storybook

image.alt: Aura Avatar sizes; User avatar is built on this component

context.summary: Nineteen more components gained portable docs, and the community page templates now ship agent skills.

cards.title: Portable docs for 19 components
cards.subtitle: Aura docs
cards.text: Alert, Badge, Input, Slider, Tooltip and 14 more now have markdown docs and example galleries.
cards.label: View a gallery

cards.title: Agent skills for page templates
cards.subtitle: Community
cards.text: The Record list, Dashboard and Map layout templates each install a skill that guides coding agents to use them.
